mapper.select: SELECT c.ChapterId, c.ChapterNo, c.ViewCount, c.StoryId, s.Slug AS StorySlug, s.Title AS StoryTitle, s.AuthorId AS Author_AuthorId, s.AuthorName AS Author_PenName, v.VolumeId AS Volume_VolumeId, v.VolumeNo AS Volume_VolumeNo, v.Title AS Volume_Title, (SELECT TOP (1) p.ChapterId FROM dbo.Chapter p WHERE p.StoryId = c.StoryId AND p.ChapterNo < c.ChapterNo AND p.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY p.ChapterNo DESC) AS PrevChapterId, (SELECT TOP (1) n.ChapterId FROM dbo.Chapter n WHERE n.StoryId = c.StoryId AND n.ChapterNo > c.ChapterNo AND n.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND n.IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY n.ChapterNo ASC) AS NextChapterId FROM dbo.Chapter c JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = c.StoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.Volume v ON v.VolumeId = c.VolumeId WHERE c.ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND c.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.IsDeleted = 0
SELECT c.StoryId FROM dbo.Chapter c JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = c.StoryId WHERE c.ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND c.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.IsDeleted = 0
